description: Developer Tool & IDE Selection - Allow developers to choose which AI tools and IDEs Baton configures, both globally and per-project, with resolution chain: Detection → Global Config → Project Preferences

userStories.title: Create preferences schema and types
userStories.description: As a developer of Baton core, I need a Zod schema for .baton/preferences.yaml so that project preferences are validated consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: New file packages/core/src/preferences/preferences-schema.ts with projectPreferencesSchema
Schema validates: version: '1.0', ai: { useGlobal: boolean, tools: string[] }, ide: { useGlobal: boolean, platforms: string[] }
tools and platforms default to []
Invalid version values are rejected
Type ProjectPreferences exported via z.infer<typeof projectPreferencesSchema>
Unit tests in preferences-schema.test.ts cover valid, default, and invalid cases
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add read/write/delete for project preferences file
userStories.description: As a developer of Baton core, I need I/O functions for .baton/preferences.yaml so that CLI commands can persist and retrieve project preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: New file packages/core/src/preferences/preferences-io.ts
getPreferencesPath(projectRoot) returns path.join(projectRoot, '.baton', 'preferences.yaml')
readProjectPreferences(projectRoot) returns parsed ProjectPreferences or null if file doesn't exist
writeProjectPreferences(projectRoot, prefs) writes YAML, creates .baton/ directory if needed
deleteProjectPreferences(projectRoot) removes the file
All file operations use fs/promises
Unit tests in preferences-io.test.ts cover read (exists/missing), write (dir exists/missing), and delete
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow the same YAML I/O pattern as loadGlobalConfig / saveGlobalConfig in core/src/config/global-config.ts

userStories.title: Implement preference resolution chain
userStories.description: As a developer of Baton core, I need a resolver that merges project preferences with global config so that sync and other commands get the correct effective tool list.
acceptanceCriteria: New file packages/core/src/preferences/preferences-resolver.ts
resolvePreferences(projectRoot) returns ResolvedPreferences with ai: { source, tools } and ide: { source, platforms }
When no preferences.yaml exists, source is 'global' and tools come from getGlobalAiTools()
When useGlobal: true, source is 'global' and tools come from global config
When useGlobal: false, source is 'project' and tools come from project preferences
Mixed configs work: AI from project + IDE from global (and vice versa)
Unit tests in preferences-resolver.test.ts cover all resolution paths
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Uses getGlobalAiTools() and getGlobalIdePlatforms() from core/src/config/global-config.ts for the global fallback path

userStories.title: Create barrel export and register in core index
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the preferences module exported from @baton-dx/core so CLI commands can import it.
acceptanceCriteria: New file packages/core/src/preferences/index.ts with barrel exports
packages/core/src/index.ts re-exports: projectPreferencesSchema, ProjectPreferences, readProjectPreferences, writeProjectPreferences, deleteProjectPreferences, resolvePreferences, ResolvedPreferences
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate preferences into sync command
userStories.description: As a user, I want baton sync to use my project preferences so that only my selected tools are synced.
acceptanceCriteria: In packages/cli/src/commands/sync.ts, replace getGlobalAiTools() and getGlobalIdePlatforms() with resolvePreferences(projectRoot)
syncedAiTools sourced from prefs.ai.tools, syncedIdePlatforms from prefs.ide.platforms
When --verbose: log source attribution, e.g. 'AI tools: claude-code, cursor (from project preferences)'
Existing sync tests continue to pass (no preferences file = global fallback = same behavior)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Enhanced multiselect in baton ai-tools scan
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose which detected AI tools to save during scan so I don't save tools I don't actively use.
acceptanceCriteria: After detection, show @clack/prompts multiselect instead of confirm
Detected tools are pre-selected; all 14 tools listed with non-detected tools unselected
Each option shows detection status: 'Claude Code (detected)' vs 'GitHub Copilot'
Selected tools saved via setGlobalAiTools(selectedKeys)
--yes flag skips multiselect and saves only detected tools (preserves current behavior)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use getAllAdapters() from core/src/adapters/registry.ts for the full list of 14 tools

userStories.title: Enhanced multiselect in baton ides scan
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose which detected IDEs to save during scan so I control my IDE config.
acceptanceCriteria: Same multiselect pattern as US-006 but for IDE platforms
All 6 IDE platforms listed; detected ones pre-selected
Each option shows detection status
--yes saves only detected (current behavior preserved)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use getRegisteredIdePlatforms() from core/src/ide/platform-registry.ts for the full list of 6 IDEs

userStories.title: Add baton ai-tools configure command (global mode)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manually configure my global AI tools without re-scanning so I can add or remove tools at will.
acceptanceCriteria: New file packages/cli/src/commands/ai-tools/configure.ts
Shows multiselect of all 14 tools; currently-saved tools pre-selected with '(currently saved)' label
Saves selection to global config via setGlobalAiTools()
Registered as subcommand in packages/cli/src/commands/ai-tools/index.ts
--yes is a no-op (keeps current selection unchanged)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This story covers only global mode. The --project flag is added in US-010 after the preferences module is wired.

userStories.title: Add baton ides configure command (global mode)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manually configure my global IDE platforms without re-scanning.
acceptanceCriteria: New file packages/cli/src/commands/ides/configure.ts
Same multiselect pattern as US-008 but for IDE platforms (6 platforms)
Saves to global config via setGlobalIdePlatforms()
Registered as subcommand in packages/cli/src/commands/ides/index.ts
--yes is a no-op (keeps current selection unchanged)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Mirror of US-008 for IDEs. --project flag added later.

userStories.title: Add --project flag to ai-tools configure command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure AI tools at the project level so I can customize which tools are used per-project.
acceptanceCriteria: Add --project flag to packages/cli/src/commands/ai-tools/configure.ts
--project shows project-level multiselect with context (global config + detected tools listed)
--project includes follow-up: 'Use selection above' vs 'Use global config' — writes .baton/preferences.yaml accordingly
--project without a baton.yaml in current directory shows error
--yes with --project writes useGlobal: true
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-004 (preferences module) and US-008 (base configure command)

userStories.title: Add --project flag to ides configure command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure IDE platforms at the project level.
acceptanceCriteria: Add --project flag to packages/cli/src/commands/ides/configure.ts
Same --project flow as US-010 but for IDE platforms
--project without a baton.yaml shows error
--yes with --project writes useGlobal: true
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add first-run preferences prompt to init command
userStories.description: As a user running baton init, I want to be asked once about project-level tool preferences so the file is created and I'm never prompted again.
acceptanceCriteria: In packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts, after auto-scan and profile selection but before sync
Only triggers when .baton/preferences.yaml does not exist
Shows: 'How do you want to configure AI tools for this project?' with options: 'Use global config' (default) / 'Customize for this project'
Same question for IDEs
'Customize' opens multiselect (global tools pre-selected + detected tools available)
Writes .baton/preferences.yaml with appropriate useGlobal values
--yes writes preferences.yaml with useGlobal: true for both categories silently
Preferences file only needs to exist to suppress future prompts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-004 (preferences module). The preferences prompt is new UI; keep it lightweight.

userStories.title: Add first-run preferences prompt to sync command
userStories.description: As a user running baton sync for the first time, I want the same preferences prompt so my preferences are captured.
acceptanceCriteria: In packages/cli/src/commands/sync.ts, before the resolve step, check for .baton/preferences.yaml
If missing, show same prompt as US-012
--yes writes useGlobal: true silently
If preferences already exist, no prompt
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Extract the shared first-run prompt logic from US-012 into a reusable helper so both init and sync use it

userStories.title: Add project preference options to baton manage wizard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure project tools from the manage wizard so I don't have to remember separate commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Add three new options to the manage wizard select in packages/cli/src/commands/manage.ts:
Option 'Configure AI tools for this project' opens same multiselect as configure --project
Option 'Configure IDEs for this project' does same for IDEs
Option 'Reset project preferences to global' sets useGlobal: true for both categories
Options appear after existing options but before 'Remove Baton' and 'Quit'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Show resolved preferences in baton config dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want baton config to show where my tool configuration comes from so I understand the resolution chain.
acceptanceCriteria: In the 'Developer Tools' section of showDashboard() in packages/cli/src/commands/config.ts, show source attribution
Format: 'AI Tools: claude-code, cursor (from project preferences)' or 'AI Tools: claude-code, cursor, windsurf (from global config)'
Same for IDE platforms
When in a project directory with preferences, calls resolvePreferences() to get source info
When not in a project (no baton.yaml), shows global config only (current behavior)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Auto-gitignore .baton/preferences.yaml
userStories.description: As a user, I want preferences.yaml to be automatically gitignored so my personal tool choices don't affect teammates.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify that existing baton init .baton/ gitignore entry covers preferences.yaml
If writeProjectPreferences() is called outside of init (e.g., from configure --project) and .baton/ is not gitignored, call updateGitignore() to add it
Add updateGitignore() call to writeProjectPreferences() in preferences-io.ts or to configure --project commands
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Existing updateGitignore() utility in @baton-dx/core handles .gitignore updates — reuse it
